title: vicia biflora var. cossoniana
intro: Vicia biflora var. cossoniana, commonly known as Cosson's vetch or vetch, is a plant species in the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Vicia biflora var. cossoniana include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic activities. Bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
